title: Arriving in New Orleans, filling in on drums, starting trumpet in 1927
summary: After moving in 1919 Ernie lived with his brother, who played with Albert Duconge's group, and he sat in on drums in the mid-1920s. In 1927 he began trumpet with Arnold Metoyer.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Picking up the horn: first instrument and the trombone

blocks.x: Did you continue playing drum until you started playing trumpet or? Oh no.
I left Madisonville in 1919. I came over here and lived with my brother. And at that time, he came here and joined the band with Albert Glennie and...

And this guy that used to call him Nutzi. I believe his name was Alonzo who was playing clarinet. And Ambrose on trombone. I forget who was playing the banjo. Well that's the band he was with then. Was there any special name to that band? No, they didn't have a special name to that band or? No, they didn't have a special name to that particular band at that time. And I was living with him then. And occasionally I would go around when he would go and play, he would take me with him.

And later on around 1924, 25 like that, he would take me out on jobs and he would leave me sit down and sit down and play. And I played myself with George Lewis and D.D. and Billy on drums. Did you tell us yet when you started trumpet? You played drums a long time then. Well just off and on, just filling in. You were 17. 1927 I started playing trumpet in 1927. He was my teacher there. He was my teacher there. He was stuff with with George Lewis and Dee Dee and Billy on drums. Did you tell us yet when you started trumpet? I started playing trumpet 1927. You were playing drums a long time then. Just filling in. 1927 I started on trumpet on all my twi. He was my teacher. He taught me just about, I think it was about five years after he turned Albert Snaya. Albert Snaya was one of his last students he had before I went to him. Matter of fact, I wanted to go on Manuel Perez, that's who his brother was on. But he had stopped teaching at the time so I went on Alma Twi. He was a very good teacher.
